identities.name: Bourke Post Office
identities.address: 47 Oxley Street, Bourke, New South Wales, Australia

mapIdentity.scope: The postal node and state heritage parcel locate the building. The two-storey porch frontage, exterior proportions and rear wing are aligned to the cadastral street line. Detailed massing dimensions are estimated from architectural evidence.

note: Government Architect’s photograph shows the two-tier iron hip roof, two tall corbelled stacks, five rows of scalloped timber fringe and fine verandah ironwork. The state heritage record documents the extant 1901 lobby, cream and red brick and attached rear additions.
